def factor_positive_confluence(df):
    """Captures days when both price and volume are above their recent averages, indicating bullish confluence."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    # price deviation from 20-day EMA
    ema20 = df_copy["close"].ewm(span=20, adjust=False).mean()
    price_dev = df_copy["close"] / ema20 - 1
    # volume deviation from 20-day SMA
    vol_ma = df_copy["volume"].rolling(20, min_periods=5).mean()
    vol_dev = df_copy["volume"] / vol_ma - 1
    # only positive confluence: price above EMA and volume above average
    pos_price = np.maximum(0, price_dev)
    pos_vol = np.maximum(0, vol_dev)
    df_copy["factor_positive_confluence"] = pos_price * pos_vol
    return df_copy["factor_positive_confluence"]
description: This factor captures the conjunction of positive price momentum and volume expansion—a classic confirmation signal. By taking the product of the positive parts of the deviations from recent averages, it isolates episodes where both price and volume are above their norms, reflecting strong bullish agreement. This nonlinear fusion creates a sparse but high-conviction signal that may improve MI and complement linear ranking strategies.
